name: grid-1fr-risks
method: Listed every `grid-template-columns` rule using bare `1fr` (or `repeat(N, 1fr)`) without `minmax(0, 1fr)`. Bare 1fr collapses to content width when a child has `min-content` larger than the column would otherwise be (e.g. a long unbroken token like a URL or a wide image without max-width:100%). The fix pattern is `minmax(0, 1fr)` so the track can shrink below content min-content.

highest_impact.risk: Medium — media grids host tags that already enforce `max-width:100%`, so collapse risk is low in practice. But long captions / file names emitted as overlay text without `word-wrap` can overflow.
Low — children are user-supplied widgets; child `min-width` is usually 0 already.
Low — search input + button; button has fixed width; input has flex-grow.

highest_impact.selector: BP profile + group media tab grids (lines 781, 788, 800, 812, 840)
highest_impact.risk: Medium — BP themes (BuddyX, BuddyBoss) commonly inject long activity text. The mvs-bp-* containers under #buddypress can collapse on narrow theme widths because `repeat(6, 1fr)` (line 812) leaves no room for image min-content. Recommend `minmax(0, 1fr)` for line 812.

result.risk: Low — same as the frontend.css mvs-media-grid mirror; img max-width:100% is the safety net.

notes: Systemic CSS pattern (predates 1.2.0). One concrete real-world bug class: BP integration grids on narrow tablet widths under a theme that injects unbreakable strings (long URLs in activity text mirrored into media tabs) — line 812 `repeat(6, 1fr)` is the most likely candidate. No 1.2.0 regressions: pdf-viewer + member-photos blocks delegate grid to the existing media-grid wrapper, so they inherit this pattern but don't add new bare-1fr rules of their own. RTL CSS files are mirrors of LTR — counted only once. Skipped phpcs.xml-suppressed CSS (vendor/) and minified files.
